status.description: Outside-actor lifecycle vocabulary — the orchestrator's view of the session. Standard minih outside-state enum; matches coordination-loop-validator and other coordinated agents. Set via `minih outside state set` when the operator wants the companion to react to session-level transitions (e.g. flipping to 'paused' while the orchestrator is investigating a finding, or 'done' before sending control:stop).

data.description: Free-form scratch for outside-actor context — typical fields: 'phase' (the orchestrator's current phase/task id), 'plan' (path or slug of the active plan), 'commitsReviewed' (count), 'lastReviewedSha'.
